examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A padded card with a title and its info hint, the chart, and a footer naming the range. The chart inside takes its accessible name from the card title.

examples.name: Content
examples.summary: Padded content for a chart with axes and a legend; flush content for an edge-to-edge plot.

examples.name: WithControls
examples.summary: The aggregation and variation tags sit before the options menu. The menu carries Copy query and Export CSV, the two paths a person takes to move this data into another tool.

examples.name: Resizable
examples.summary: Drag the corner to change the span and the height, or focus it: Left and Right change the span by one column, Up and Down the height by 24 pixels.

examples.name: Draggable
examples.summary: Three cards on a 12-column grid. Drag a card by its handle to drop it on another, or focus the handle and use the arrow keys. The page owns the order; the card only reports the gesture.

examples.name: MetricPanel
examples.summary: The metric panel of a metrics page: one card per metric with the current value, its unit, the change against the previous period and a sparkline of the period. A rise in latency is bad, so that panel sets inverse.
